text:
Served items: 6 maki sushi pieces with chicken and cucumber (about 40 g each, roughly 240 g in total), a glass of orange juice (about 200 ml), and a glass of water.

Sushi: about 6 × 50 kcal = 300 kcal. Rice makes up most of this at about 60 g carbs per 240 g. Chicken with mayo adds fat.

Orange juice: about 200 ml, around 90 kcal, 21 g carbs, 1.5 g protein.

Total served is about 390 kcal.

I can't tell from a before-eating photo what will be left over, so I assumed the person eats everything and set leftover to 0. That makes the eaten total equal to the served total, 390 kcal.

Macros for the sushi: about 9 g protein, 52 g carbs, 6 g fat. Adding the juice gives about 10.5 g protein, 73 g carbs, 6.5 g fat.
